notes: New releases must reach newModelMinimumAccuracy, judged on AA's whole-percent display (rounded half up).
grandfatheredReleases were already listed when the 35% rule was introduced; they keep the older minimum.
Only the newest eligible release per creator and product line is shown.
A run that would remove, add or re-score more models than these limits is blocked and reported as a failure.
Removed/added count whole product lines, so a newer release replacing an older one is not a removal.
A model counts as re-scored when its accuracy moves by more than changedAccuracyPoints or its OI by more than changedIndexPoints.
If such a change is genuine, re-run the update workflow manually with 'Allow large changes' ticked.
